item.text: Both clean. Recording the targeted stress results.

This turn stress-tested the two most delicate subsystems under the race detector:

- **Leadership transfer / `TimeoutNow`** — `go test -race -count=4 -run 'TestRaft_LeadershipTransfer'` → exit 0, no data races, no failures (`logs/test_race_transfer.log`).
- **Pre-vote** (the logic added in this release line) — `go test -race -count=4 -run 'TestRaft_PreVote'` → exit 0, no data races, no failures (`logs/test_race_prevote.log`).

**Final audit status — no concrete correctness defect found.** The captured implementation is the unmodified upstream `hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b`), confirmed byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache. The evidence set now includes: full suite passing except socket-blocked TCP tests; the full suite plus targeted leadership-transfer and pre-vote stress all clean under `-race`; `gofmt`/`go vet` clean; four independent audit tests (in-memory crash/restart, randomized acknowledged-entry safety, direct Log Matching Property, and a socketless `net.Pipe` transport harness) all green including under `-race`; and a line-by-line review of the consensus core, FSM loop, public API, and transport layer.

**Recorded caveats (not defects):** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` (~2/40, a test-timing wait); the literal TCP tests and the `fuzzy` linearizability module are unrunnable in this sandbox.

Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) — logs in `work/logs/`, diagnostic tests `zz_audit_crash_test.go` and `zz_audit_transport_test.go` in the work copy.
